title: 无限幻觉下的极限生成
summary: 本文在语言极限生成框架下，引入精度和召回率概念，分析枚举、新颖性和有效性约束下的生成问题。关键贡献是允许无限次错误但频率趋于零（精度保持为1），证明此松弛可在对手永久隐藏大部分目标语言时严格提高召回率。同时研究新颖性约束的连续松弛，要求固定比例输出新颖。结果向更现实的模型迈进，允许可控的错误和重复。
summary_en: This paper introduces precision and recall into the language generation in the limit framework, analyzing generation under constraints on enumeration, novelty, and validity. A key contribution is allowing infinitely many mistakes with frequency tending to zero (precision remains 1), showing this relaxation strictly increases recall when the adversary permanently withholds a large portion of the target language. It also studies a continuous relaxation of the novelty constraint. Results move toward a more realistic model where occasional errors and repetitions are unavoidable but rates are controlled.
